title: Session-anchored spiral promote with lease coordinator and shadow replay
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: We need a rollout primitive that (1) guarantees session-consistent cutovers for stateful frontends and streaming sessions, (2) gives a graceful spiral promotion pattern for gradual exposure, and (3) avoids race conditions where overlapping promotions from concurrent pipelines can lead to split-brain traffic routing. This PR introduces a LeaseCoordinator plus a session-anchored spiral promote controller and a shadow-replay capture path for A/B validation.

Highlights: Added a lightweight distributed lease (LeaseCoordinator) used by the promote controller so only a single coordinator can advance a given model swap in a region, preventing concurrent conflicting promotes; implemented "spiral promote" strategy that ramps traffic up in small spiral increments anchored to session keys (cookie/session token) to preserve affinity during cutover; added shadow-replay capture that records paired responses for real user traffic for offline A/B regression checks and automated rollback-oracle input.

Design summary: The LeaseCoordinator uses the existing coordination KV store (consensus-backed TTL leases) with a new Lease TTL and renew semantics and exposes a guarded API used only by rollout controllers. The SpiralPromoteController leverages session hash bucketing so increments route whole-session buckets rather than per-request fractions; this reduces mid-session model mixing. Spiral promotes are parameterized by base_fraction, step_delta, max_fraction and hold_window. The controller publishes per-step telemetry for SLO gating. ShadowReplay captures request/response pairs and writes to the replay buffer with metadata tags (cohort, step, session_id, trace_id) and an idempotent append-only writer.

Safety and rollback: We wired the controller into the MetricGate system: multiple SLO alarms (p95 latency > threshold, error-rate delta, qualitative regression signals from evals) will cause an immediate stepback and if sustained trigger the rollback-oracle which records a recommended revert and quarantines the model. The LeaseCoordinator enforces single-threaded rollouts so rollbacks can't interleave with promotes. We also included a runtime fallback policy that routes affected sessions to the prior pinned model if any anomaly is detected mid-session.

Compatibility: All new controllers opt-in via the rollout manifest field "promoteStrategy: spiral-lease". Existing canary controllers continue to work. The LeaseCoordinator falls back to optimistic single-controller behavior for older clusters that don't support the KV lease extension.

Testing and rollout plan: Unit tests for coordinator/lease expiry, e2e integration tests that simulate session flows across spiral steps, and an e2e smoke that runs against a dry-run namespace. We will ship to canary cluster for one week with a controlled ephemeral experiment, then a staged rollout across regions.

Related work: builds on ENG-1934 (cohort safety gates) and ENG-2001 (session affinity primitives). Runtime optimization of the session hashing is intentionally small (to avoid CPU regressions) and pairs with Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching affinity-aware requests.

Notes: This PR touches sensitive routing and should be monitored with the provided runbook (docs/runbooks/model_rollouts.md).

d4e5f6g: implement spiral promote controller with session bucketing and metric hooks
h7i8j9k: add shadow-replay capture path, append-only writer and protobuf tags
l0m1n2o: add console UI for Spiral strategy, docs and runbook, e2e tests and lint fixes
review_comments: Liam Chen: Can we make the Lease TTL configurable per-cluster? I want to avoid false positives on slow control planes. Requested change: add cluster-level override and validate that renew is resilient to transient KV timeouts.

Asha Patel: Responded - added cluster.override_lease_ttl and a renewal jitter. Also included a mitigation note in docs/upgrade/lease-coordinator-migration.md describing how to tune the TTL for slower control planes.
Sophia Nguyen: Concern about memory usage from shadow-replay capture under bursty traffic; requested backpressure and sampling knobs.
Asha Patel: Implemented exponential sample-backoff and rate-limiter for the append path; added metrics to alert on queue depth.
release_notes: Introduces a session-anchored spiral promote rollout strategy and a LeaseCoordinator to prevent concurrent conflicting promotes. Adds shadow-replay capture for A/B validation and telemetry hooks for metric gating. Opt-in via promoteStrategy: spiral-lease. See docs/runbooks/model_rollouts.md for operational guidance.
test_plan: Local unit tests + integration suite run in CI. E2E smoke deployed to canary cluster with a small synthetic traffic generator that verifies session affinity across spiral steps. Monitor rollout_events, rollout_metrics.prom and shadow_replay_queue_depth. If any SLO gate trips, automation steps back; human ops notified via runbook alerts.
postmerge_actions: Deploy helm chart to canary namespace, enable promoteStrategy flag for ~10% of internal tenants, run lease stress test for 48 hours, and schedule a follow-up telemetry review (ENG-1934).
notes: This change requires console and API versions to be deployed together to use the new manifest fields. Backwards compatibility checks included; cluster without the lease KV extension will use optimistic promotes (logged). See docs/upgrade/lease-coordinator-migration.md.
changelog_entry: Feature: session-anchored spiral promote + LeaseCoordinator (opt-in) - adds safer, session-consistent rollouts and shadow capture for A/B regression tests.
security_review: Not a security-sensitive PR; used existing KMS-backed control plane for lease tokens.
observability_notes: New metrics: rollout_step_fraction, rollout_step_hold_seconds, lease_renew_errors, shadow_replay_queue_depth. Dashboards added under Rollouts > SpiralPromotes.
rollback_playbook: Automatic: metric gate stepback -> rollback-oracle quarantine. Manual: runbook outlines forced revert via CLI: redwood rollout revert --model <id> --region <r> with session drain window. See docs/runbooks/model_rollouts.md
